turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: the zero goes back to what it should be, and I want to know why nobody called me before it was entered.
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
"The end of it." That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
I don't need more proof than that.

"I don't need more proof than that." Your own procedure, 4.3, says software results don't by themselves establish a concern, and I have it printed in my bag. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero, yes or no?
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
"Unlike some people." I'm writing that down. My child never lies, so who exactly are you calling a liar, Hale?

"Zero stands." Based on a score, with no conversation with Owen and no call to me, which is exactly what your own procedure rules out. I'll be in the principal's office when we're done, so tell me now: is there a single document besides that number?
